beruhigung: You haven’t done anything wrong. On the first start and with large libraries this can take a few minutes. This page reloads by itself.
weiter: As soon as Ablago is ready, it continues here by itself – to sign-in, to the setup assistant or to the load test page.
schritt.datenbank-warten: The database is not reachable yet – new attempt {nr} of {von}
schritt.sperre: The database is locked: another Ablago on the same database is updating it right now. Ablago waits until it is done.
schritt.ordner: Checking folders for files and exports
fehler.neuere-datenbank: The database comes from a newer version of Ablago ({anzahl} unknown migrations, the latest {letzte}). An older version must not use it, otherwise permissions or locks would be lost.
fehler.neuere-datenbank.tun: Set the image back to the newer version (e.g. the tag :stabil) and restart the container. Going back to an older version is only possible with a backup made with that older version.
fehler.migration: The database could not be updated (step {nr} of {von}: {datei}, error code {code}). The database is unchanged, because all steps run in one transaction.
fehler.datenbank.abgewiesen: The database cannot be reached or does not accept connections.
fehler.datenbank.sperre: The database is blocked: a lock took too long.
fehler.datenbank.platte: The database can no longer write: the storage is full.
fehler.datenbank.verbindungen: The database does not accept any more connections – too many are already open.
fehler.datenbank.zu-alt: The database runs on a version of PostgreSQL that is too old. Ablago needs at least PostgreSQL {mindestens}; it is tested with {getestet}.
fehler.vorstart.rechte: The database cannot write to its folder: the permissions of the mounted database folder do not fit.
fehler.vorstart.pg-version: The database comes from a different major version of PostgreSQL than this image. So that nothing breaks, it does not start.
fehler.vorstart.pg-17: The database still comes from PostgreSQL 17. This version of dms-komplett includes PostgreSQL 18, which cannot open a database from 17. So that nothing breaks, it does not start – nothing is deleted.
fehler.vorstart.nicht-leer: The database folder is not empty but contains no database. So that nothing is overwritten, Ablago does not create one there.
fehler.vorstart.pg-anlegen: The database could not be created.
fehler.vorstart.pg-beendet: The database was stopped – during start-up or while running.
fehler.vorstart.daten-rechte: Ablago cannot write to one of its folders: since this version Ablago no longer runs as administrator (root), and the permissions of a mounted folder do not fit its user.
fehler.tun.neustart.komplett: Restart the container: in your NAS’s container manager with “Restart”, or with docker restart and the container’s name.
fehler.tun.neustart.extern: Check that the database container is running and restart it; then restart Ablago’s container.
fehler.tun.sperre: Is a second Ablago running on the same database, e.g. an old container? Stop it, then restart the container.
fehler.tun.speicher: Free up space on the storage that holds the database (e.g. delete old backups or exports), then restart the container.
fehler.tun.verbindungen: Stop other programs on the same database or allow more connections in PostgreSQL (max_connections), then restart the container.
fehler.tun.pg-zu-alt: Move to a database with PostgreSQL {getestet}: create a backup with your current version of Ablago, start an empty database container with postgres:{getestet} and restore the backup in the setup assistant.
fehler.tun.rechte: Check the permissions of the database folder on your NAS (or use a named Docker volume), then restart the container.
fehler.tun.pg-version: Set the image back to the version the database was created with. Moving to a new major version works via backup and restore.
fehler.tun.pg-17: Create a backup with Ablago {version} (the last version with PostgreSQL 17): set the image to dms-komplett:{version}, start the container and create a backup under Workbench → Backup.
fehler.tun.pg-17-ordner: Then empty the database folder (safest: rename it, e.g. to postgres-17, and create an empty one), start this version and restore the backup in the setup assistant (“Restore from a backup”). Delete the old folder only once everything runs.
fehler.tun.nicht-leer: Check the contents of the database folder on your NAS. If it is empty, Ablago creates a new database on the next start.
fehler.tun.daten-rechte: Apply one of the fixes above and restart the container. The container log has the same details – if there are none above, it names the reason (e.g. PUID or PGID are not numbers).
rechte.gesehen: Folder “{ordner}”: owned by {besitzer} (permissions {rechte}), Ablago runs as {jetzt}.

fehler.tun: The exact message is in the container’s log (docker logs with the container’s name, or in your NAS’s container manager under “Log”). The manual page “Troubleshooting” helps you with the message. Your data and backups are not affected.
fehler.neustart: Ablago will exit in a few minutes so that the container restarts and tries again.
api: Ablago is starting. Please try again in a few seconds.
api.fehler: Ablago could not start. The reason is shown on the start page and in the container’s log.
